record_title: A nonuniform DCT limit for the AR(1) KLT under growing block length
provenance: Source-specific asymptotic analysis of the AR(1) KLT phase equation and exact DCT-core factorization in arXiv:2609.20221v1, with comparison to classical AR(1) KLT/DCT literature.
limitations: The sharp result concerns the principal KLT basis vector and yields a one-row obstruction to uniform full-transform convergence. It does not characterize the complete correction matrices, coding gain, rate-distortion loss, floating-point behavior, or a full transform-norm asymptotic.
